title: Pause at Seven Seconds
status: concept-proposal (Creative Director, 2026-11-19; not approved; awaiting owner review)
hook_line: Pause at seven seconds. Count the people.
first_visual: A grainy laundromat CCTV monitor, timestamp 04:12:07.

beats.visual: CCTV monitor graphic over clip 1, timestamp 04:12; caption PAUSE AT 0:07.
beats.vo: Pause at seven seconds. Count the people.

beats.visual: Half-second CCTV flash: Ivy, plus three faces in porthole reflections.
Ivy turns at the glitch; the chairs are empty.
Ivy rewinds the CCTV monitor and leans close.
Slow replay of 0:07 with circles: three faces in three portholes. COUNT: 4.
Key moment: Ivy leans to the nearest porthole: three faces look back, and her reflection is missing; moth on the lint sign.
beats.vo: Then I looked. And I wasn't there.

beats.visual: Card: 'What did you count? Comment before you rewatch.'

ending: Ivy looks into the nearest dryer glass: their faces, but not hers.
loop_note: Partial. The card sends viewers back to 0:07 (rewatch-driven).

interactive_prompt.reveal: in-video at 0:17, slow replay with circles (answer: 4)
interactive_prompt.comment_invite: Comment your count before you rewatch.
interactive_prompt.fairness_note: The flash frame is a real frame in the edit (12 frames at 24 fps) so a pause finds it. The answer is revealed in the same video.

originality_review: Original freeze-frame puzzle. The CCTV-flash device is generic; the porthole reflections and the missing self are ours, and they link to SH001.
scores_basis: Initial editorial judgement, 2026-11-19. topic_demand is an estimate linked to research/WEEKLY_TREND_REPORT.md categories, not a measurement of this concept.
concept: The viewer is told to pause at 0:07 and count the people. A half-second CCTV flash shows Ivy plus three faces reflected in the dryer portholes. In the room she is alone. Her own reflection is missing from the porthole.

hooks.line: Pause at seven seconds. Count the people.
hooks.first_visual: A grainy laundromat CCTV monitor, timestamp 04:12:07.

hooks.line: Count everyone in this laundromat. Then count again.
hooks.first_visual: Wide shot of a laundromat; one woman.

hooks.line: Then I looked in the porthole. And I wasn't there.
hooks.first_visual: A porthole with no reflection of the woman.

setting: Suds & Spin laundromat at 4 a.m.; CCTV monitor; dryer row.
conflict: Ivy and the viewer both try to establish who is there.
escalation: Flash frame, empty chairs, rewinding the CCTV.
reveal: Slow replay: three faces in three portholes. Count = four.
emotional_objective: Hunt, then a cold erasure (links to SH001's dryer, an easter-egg universe).
